# Totallympics

> > The premier online community for Olympic sports enthusiasts, featuring comprehensive forums, qualification trackers, and event coverage for Summer and Winter Olympic Games.

Totallympics serves as a dedicated hub for Olympic sports discussion, tracking qualification pathways for Los Angeles 2028 and Milano Cortina 2026, and providing detailed coverage of international sporting events including ISSF shooting competitions and FIS World Cup events. The community includes national team threads and specialized clubs for country-specific Olympic discussions.

## Key Topics

- Olympic Sports Discussion
- Los Angeles 2028 Qualification
- Milano Cortina 2026
- Summer Olympic Sports
- Winter Olympic Sports
- ISSF Shooting Competitions
- Paralympic Games
- National Olympic Teams
- Olympic Qualification Trackers
- International Sporting Events
- FIS World Cup
- WBSC World Baseball Classic
- Community Forums
- Event Coverage

## Core Resources

- [Totallympics Homepage](https://totallympics.com): Homepage for Olympic sports community forum and LA 2028 qualification tracker
- [Forums Index](https://totallympics.com/forums): Main forums index for Olympic sports discussion and LA 2028 qualification
- [National Threads](https://totallympics.com/forums/forum/80-national-threads): National teams discussion forum index for country-specific Olympic topics

## Summer Olympic Sports

- [Summer Olympic Sports Sections](https://totallympics.com/forums/forum/13-summer-olympic-sports-sections): Summer Olympic sports forum sections covering archery, badminton, baseball
- [Shooting ISSF World Cup 2019](https://totallympics.com/forums/topic/1448-shooting-issf-world-cup-2019): ISSF World Cup 2019 shooting competition discussion thread
- [ISSF Shotgun Junior World Cup Database](https://totallympics.com/forums/topic/10753-shooting-issf-shotgun-junior-world-cup-shotgun): ISSF Shotgun Junior World Cup results database and competition records

## Winter Olympic Sports

- [Winter Olympic Sports Sections](https://totallympics.com/forums/forum/57-winter-olympic-sports-sections): Winter Olympic sports forums for alpine skiing, biathlon, Milano Cortina 2026
- [Telemark FIS World Cup 2019](https://totallympics.com/events/event/7055-telemark-fis-world-cup-2019-bad-hindelangoberjoch): Telemark FIS World Cup 2019 event coverage at Bad Hindelang/Oberjoch
- [Beijing 2022 Replay Guide](https://totallympics.com/forums/topic/12410-how-to-watch-previous-day-replays-without-spoilers): Beijing 2022 Winter Olympics replay streaming guide without spoilers

## Paralympic Sports

- [Rio 2016 Paralympic Qualification](https://totallympics.com/forums/topic/128-summer-paralympic-games-2016-qualification): Rio 2016 Paralympic Games qualification discussion and athlete quotas
